verdict.rationale: First-party docs consistently describe one API and one key for hundreds of models across providers. They also say you can switch providers and models with minimal code changes, and that OpenAI Chat Completions compatibility lets existing OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs work after a base-URL swap. Coverage extends beyond text to embeddings, image, video, voice and reranking through the same API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the unified API behaves consistently across providers (all evidence is vendor documentation).
